table_validation.partitions: T0, T1b, T2 including rotated splits, T2b, T3, T4 inside/outside and composition, T5 uniqueness and subset

methods.quantiles: pandas linear interpolation, excluding missing values; xh itself retains 0 if present; ratios require xh>0
methods.buckets: Right closed: exact upper edges enter the lower bucket. ≤1 aspect bucket explicitly retained. Zero chars printed separately.
methods.percentages: 0–100, denominator is the printed n unless column names specify a chars≤10 or group subset; empty denominator=null.
methods.owner_unique: Unique matched census lines; good=any good judgment, bad=any bad judgment; conflicts counted in both and listed explicitly.
methods.false_rejects: Owner-good unique lines, verdict!=KEEP. Missing/conflicting replay verdicts excluded and availability printed. No owner label inferred from reader_state.
methods.T6: Version-specific histograms on unique owner-good lines; 05 and 08 can overlap. 08 categories use literal after.reason, retained in owner_joined.
methods.T4: Rows for inside and outside, census composition, each owner set/sheet plus unique, and readers. Unmatched source rows excluded from dimensional comparisons and listed in metadata.
methods.replay_resolution: Both replay files retained. Identical versions collapse; conflicting version values become null and are listed.
methods.T2b: All census rows pooled; same break-curve columns as T2, by each dimension bucket.
methods.scope: Descriptive only; no judgments or recommendations. No images/network/Clariden accessed.
